# Production Board

## Overview

The Production Board is a visual Kanban-style interface for managing job workflows. It displays all active jobs as draggable cards organised into columns. You can switch between two views — **Timeline** (grouped by due date) and **Status** (grouped by job status) — and drag jobs between columns to update them instantly.

Access the Production Board from the main navigation or by clicking **Production Board** from the Dashboard.

---

## Views

### Timeline View

Jobs are arranged into columns by due date:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Past Due** | Jobs with a due date before today. Highlighted in red. |
| **Today** | Jobs due today. Highlighted in amber. |
| **Tomorrow, next 7 days** | One column per day for the upcoming week. |
| **Future** | Jobs due more than 7 days from now. |

Dragging a job to a different day column updates its due date. You cannot drag jobs into the **Past Due** column — set a future date instead.

### Status View

Jobs are arranged into columns by their workflow status:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **New** | Newly created jobs awaiting production. |
| **In Production** | Jobs currently being worked on. |
| **Completed** | Finished jobs. Jobs dragged here are removed from the board. |
| **Custom statuses** | If your organisation has configured custom status labels (e.g. "Hold", "Waiting for Artwork"), they appear as additional columns. |
| **Outsourced** | Jobs flagged as outsourced appear in a separate column on the right. |

Dragging a job to a different status column updates its status immediately.

Switch between views using the **Timeline** and **Status** tabs in the toolbar.

---

## Job Cards

Each card on the board shows key information at a glance:

- **Job number** — the unique identifier (e.g. J-1042).
- **Customer name** — from the linked order.
- **Product name** — what is being produced.
- **Due date** — shown relative to today ("Today", "Tomorrow", or formatted date). Overdue dates are shown in red, today's date in amber.
- **Quantity** — displayed as a badge (e.g. x3).
- **Process badge** — if the job is assigned to a process, a colour-coded badge is shown.
- **Outsource badge** — if the job is outsourced, a badge shows the supplier status ("Outsourced", "Supplier WIP", or "Supplier Complete").

### Note indicators

Small icons appear on cards when notes are present:

- **Amber speech bubble** — the order includes a customer note (e.g. special instructions submitted at checkout). Hover to preview.
- **Blue pencil** — the job has internal production notes added by your team. Hover to preview.

---

## Drag and Drop

Drag any job card and drop it onto a column to update it:

- **Timeline view**: dropping onto a day column changes the job's due date.
- **Status view**: dropping onto a status column changes the job's workflow status.

When a job is dragged to the **Completed** column in status view, it is removed from the board automatically.

> **Tip**: You need to drag at least 8 pixels before a drag starts. This prevents accidental drags when clicking cards.

---

## Clicking a Job Card

Click any job card to open the **Job Detail Dialog**, where you can:

- View full job details including product, quantity, order number, and customer.
- View a thumbnail of the job's artwork (if uploaded).
- Change the **status** using a dropdown — including any custom status labels configured for your organisation.
- Edit the **due date** using a calendar picker.
- Add or update **production notes** — internal notes visible only to your team.
- Navigate to the parent order via the **View Order** link.

Changes are saved individually and update the board in real time without a full page reload.

---

## Filtering

### Search

Use the **search bar** in the toolbar to filter jobs by order number. Only jobs whose order number contains the search text will be shown.

### Location filter

If your organisation has multiple store locations, a **Location** dropdown appears. Select a specific location to show only jobs from orders assigned to that pickup location, or choose **All Locations** to see everything.

### Process filter

If your organisation uses processes (workflow categories like "Print", "Frame", "Mount"), filter buttons appear below the toolbar. Click a process name to show only jobs assigned to that process, or click **All** to clear the filter.

---

## Creating Jobs

Admins can create new jobs directly from the Production Board by clicking the **+** button next to the page title. This opens the Create Job dialog where you can select a product, set quantity, assign a process, and link to an existing order.

---

## Real-Time Updates

The Production Board listens for real-time changes from the database. When another user updates a job — or when an automated process (such as a POS integration or webhook) creates or modifies jobs — the board updates automatically without requiring a manual refresh.

---

## Tips

- Use **Timeline view** for daily production planning — see at a glance what needs to be done today and what is overdue.
- Use **Status view** for tracking workflow progress across all jobs regardless of due date.
- **Custom status columns** (e.g. "Hold") let you create intermediate workflow stages. Configure these under **Settings → Jobs**.
- The **Outsourced** column is separated from the main columns to keep your in-house workflow clear.
- Combine location and process filters to focus on a specific production area.
